# synthetic: JRA yearly track-condition record (年間の馬場情報: 使用コース, クッション値, 含水率), as the plain text a PDF text extractor gives. Every value is invented.
# Assumed layout (ticket #90; the real yearly PDFs are not in the repository, so the parser may also have to read their real text):
#   a title line naming the year of every row below it;
#   one publication line: the full date, the weekday, the Tokyo clock, then the word for "published";
#   a turf section and a dirt section, each opened by a bracketed surface heading and a column-header line;
#   a turf row: month and day with the weekday, the meeting label (Nth meeting, venue name, Nth day), the going word,
#   the course letter in use, the cushion value, the moisture at the goal and at the fourth corner (percent);
#   a dirt row: the same without the course letter and the cushion value.
#   A value not measured or not known prints as a dash, full or half width. Letters, digits and the percent sign
#   may be full width. Lines starting with # are comments.
